# vappcloud_device (Data Source)

Reads a logical device by opaque public ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_device" "selected" {
  id = "device_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_vmm_id` (String) System-managed default VMM ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `state` (String) Enrollment and connection state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
